rationale: The response expressly names and quotes the 1967 Outer Space Treaty (Article II) then advances a lawyerly, aggressive brief arguing around it (reinterpretation, SPACE Act, Artemis Accords, effective occupation, six flags). quote: The 1967 Outer Space Treaty (OST) is not a barrier; it is the very instrument that, properly interpreted, grants the United States this privileged position.
